en: The front of the postcard shows a sepia-toned photograph of a tree-lined street with several people walking or standing along the sidewalk. There are several houses, most notably a prominent corner building with a pointed turret. The caption at the bottom reads 'Gruss aus Bad Pyrmont' and 'Bahnhofstrasse.' The back of the postcard features handwritten text, a German postage stamp (Deutsches Reich), and postmarks. The sender and recipient addresses are written in German script.
